import os,re,json

G=load()
from collections import Counter

    frame=None
    for c,n in cnt.most_common():
        if c==0: continue
        cells={(r,cc) for r in range(h) for cc in range(w) if inp[r][cc]==c}
        rs=[r for r,_ in cells]; cs=[cc for _,cc in cells]
        r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)

    s=min(ih//rh,iw//rw)

            dr=(i-1)//s; dc=(j-1)//s
            v=next((vv for r,cc,vv in rest if r-mr==dr and cc-mc==dc),0)
